title: Fix current Pi session live mirroring
description: Phone does not show latest messages from the current local Pi session. Diagnose why current external/local Pi JSONL updates are not mirrored to relay/app, ensure Lyntty-managed and ordinary external Pi current sessions publish live/latest updates to mobile, add tests/evidence/commit.
notes:
Design research started after user questioned current approach. Initial OSS references: tmate/gmux use session-owned live stream plus atomic snapshot/ring-buffer replay before live fan-out; ttyd/wetty are PTY bridges and weak for history; JSONL AI viewers like agent-viewer/opentrace use daemon file watchers, offset/checkpoint dedupe, normalize appends, and push via SSE/WS. Current Lyntty lazy ensure-mirror-on-open is likely insufficient for current-session freshness.
Research result: closest references recommend daemon-owned session source of truth, append-only seq event log, live WS/SSE backfill+tail, and control lease. tmate/tmux proves attach/permission model; ttyd/wetty prove PTY WS bridge but weak history; code-server proves local workspace daemon; OpenHands proves structured agent event stream; asciinema proves replay frames. Lyntty should not rely on lazy import-on-open for current-session freshness.
User asked whether a Pi plugin/extension is a less invasive approach. Pi extension docs support session_start/session_shutdown/session_info_changed, message_update, tool_execution_start/update/end, turn_start/end, input, ctx.sessionManager, etc. Design direction: plugin-first local IPC to lynttyd for exact live structured events, with JSONL watcher fallback for sessions without extension loaded. Plugin must talk only to local lynttyd, be opt-in/nonblocking, and never relay directly.
Root-cause analysis refined: mobile can only show messages already in relay /v3 session messages. Current external Pi harness writes local Pi JSONL, not relay. Lyntty's JSONL mirror is started only by app ensure-pi-session-mirror when opening synthetic pi-local rows; once a relay row exists, opening normal relay sessions skips ensureMirror, and daemon restart loses externalPiMirrors. Therefore phone can open old relay tail but no active mirror pushes latest local JSONL appends. Happy inherited history supports server-known sessions/messages via /v1,/v2 sessions, /v3 messages, socket new-message updates, and lyntty-agent history, but not arbitrary external local session discovery/live mirroring.
User rejected lyntty pi as the primary live-sync path. Product direction: plugin-first, Claude Remote /remote-like behavior. Ordinary pi startup should load a global Lyntty Pi extension, register/attach current Pi session with local lynttyd, stream structured Pi lifecycle/message/tool events to lynttyd over local-only IPC/HTTP, and let lynttyd bridge to relay/mobile. lyntty pi remains fallback/managed spawn path, not required for current-session live sync. Extension should expose /remote or /lyntty remote status/enable command, be nonblocking if lynttyd is absent, never connect directly to relay, and JSONL watcher remains fallback for uninstrumented/old sessions.
Implemented plugin-first current Pi mirroring direction. Added global Pi extension installer (Already installed Lyntty Pi extension: /home/jc/.pi/agent/extensions/lyntty/index.ts, daemon start auto-install, local cli:install install) writing . Extension auto-posts session/message/tool events from ordinary  to local-only lynttyd control endpoints  and , registers  and  commands, fails nonblocking if lynttyd is absent, and supports process-local . Daemon bridges extension events through existing deterministic Pi relay session/mirror path and , queues early daemon-start events, suppresses JSONL fallback duplicates while extension events are active, and keeps JSONL mirror fallback. Evidence: docs/evidence/r37-pi-extension-live-mirroring.md. Verification: lyntty-cli typecheck, 4 focused CLI test files / 12 tests, git diff --check, temp-HOME built CLI  smoke. Fresh phone/APK live extension validation remains not run.

Added global Pi extension installer (lyntty remote install, daemon start auto-install, local cli:install install) writing the Pi auto-discovery file under the user's global Pi extensions directory. Extension auto-posts session/message/tool events from ordinary pi to local-only lynttyd control endpoints, registers remote and lyntty commands, fails nonblocking if lynttyd is absent, and supports process-local remote off. Evidence: docs/evidence/r37-pi-extension-live-mirroring.md. Verification: lyntty-cli typecheck, 4 focused CLI test files / 12 tests, git diff --check, temp-HOME built CLI remote install smoke.
